findings.message: 3 frames reach back further for main data than the decoder buffer of ISO/IEC 11172-3 allows, which holds one frame at the highest bitrate: the first at 0x5E4D has a main_data_begin of 76 bytes where at most 0 are allowed. Encoders such as LAME exceed it (Encspect's LAME test files show it in VBR streams from 3.20 to 3.99.5), and decoders accept it.
